title: Input copy machine run
statement: Let $k>0$ and let $x$ be a Boolean word. Starting with the input-copy machine's sweep state, its input head at the first input position, all work tapes empty with their heads at the origin, and empty output, after $2|x|+2$ steps the machine is in the done state with $x$ on work tape $0$, every other work tape empty, all work-tape heads at the origin, and the input head and output tape as in the standard word configuration.
hypotheses_covered: the machine uses tape index $0$ among its $k$ work tapes
initial configuration is the sweep state with empty work tapes
